tools.name: screen_token
tools.description:
ERC-20 token risk screen on Base. $0.01 per call in USDC — no account, no API key.

Returns risk_score(0-100), signals, token metadata, and a real Uniswap v3
on-chain slippage curve. Holder concentration and token age are not available
(would need an indexer) — marked "not_available", never guessed.

tools.name: inspect_wallet
tools.description:
Wallet profile on Base. $0.01 per call in USDC. Read-only.

Returns ETH balance, nonce, whether the address is a contract or EOA, and
balances of a curated major-token list (USDC/WETH/DAI/cbETH — not full
portfolio enumeration, which needs an indexer on EVM).

address: 0x-prefixed EVM address on Bas

tools.name: simulate_transaction
tools.description:
Preview a Base call before sending. $0.01 per call. Never sends — simulation only.

Runs eth_call + eth_estimateGas against the given call. Decodes Error(string)
and Panic(uint256) revert reasons in plain language.

to: contract/address to call
data: calldata, hex string starting with 0x (default em

tools.name: gas_price
tools.description:
Current Base gas price. $0.01 per call. Typically returns in under 2s.

Returns base fee, priority fee percentiles from the last 20 blocks, congestion
read, and three recommended (slow/normal/urgent) fee tiers with ETH cost estimate.
